title: Patterns
description: Class 1 IMO — Patterns: shape and colour patterns, number patterns and growing patterns, with olympiad logical-reasoning practice.

topics.title: Shape and Colour Patterns
topics.concept: A pattern is something that repeats in a fixed order. To continue a pattern, find the part that repeats (the unit) and say it again. In ●▲●▲●▲, the unit is ●▲, so the next is ●.

examples.solution: The unit is red-blue, so next is red.
The unit is ■ ■ ▲, so next is ■.

recap: A pattern repeats in a fixed order.
Find the repeating unit, then continue it.

quiz.explanation: The unit is ▲ ●, so after ▲ comes ●.

quiz.q: Continue the colours:  green, green, yellow, green, green, yellow, ___ ?
quiz.explanation: The unit is green-green-yellow, so the next is green.

topics.title: Number Patterns
topics.concept: Numbers can make patterns too. Skip counting makes patterns: by 2s (2, 4, 6, 8…), by 5s (5, 10, 15, 20…) and by 10s (10, 20, 30…). Find the rule (how much we add each time), then continue.

examples.solution: Add 2 each time, so next is 10.
Add 5 each time, so next is 20.

recap: Find the rule (the number you add), then continue.

quiz.explanation: Add 10 each time, so next is 40.
Each number is 3 more than the one before.

topics.title: Growing Patterns
topics.concept: Some patterns grow step by step. The pattern 1, 2, 3, 4 grows by 1. A pattern of dots can grow: 1 dot, then 2 dots, then 3 dots. Look at how much it grows each time to find the next step.

examples.solution: It grows by 1, so next is 5.

recap: Growing patterns get bigger by the same amount each step.
Find the growth, then add it again.

quiz.explanation: It grows by 2 each time, so 7 + 2 = 9.

questions.explanation: Unit is ●●▲; after ▲ it starts again with ●.

questions.q: Continue:  A B A B A ___ ?
questions.explanation: The pattern alternates A, B; after A comes B.

questions.q: Which shape is the odd one in the pattern:  ■ ■ ● ■ ■ ?

questions.explanation: Each is 10 more than the last.
Counting by 1, the missing number is 3.

questions.q: Beads pattern for a rakhi:  red, gold, red, gold, ___ ?
questions.explanation: Unit is red-gold; after gold comes red.

questions.q: Steps on a staircase go 1, 2, 3, 4 … How many steps after the 6th step is the 8th step?

questions.explanation: Skip counting by 2: the missing number is 6.

questions.q: A pattern grows: 1, 2, 4, 7, 11 … each step adds one more than before (+1, +2, +3, +4). What comes next?
